entries.text_jp: 見悵り:ダメだ! 合言葉を
entries.translation_en: Guard: No way! Say the password...

entries.text_jp: 言わないと 入れるわけには
entries.translation_en: ...or we can't let you in!

entries.text_jp: これで よろしくて?
entries.translation_en: Will this suffice?

entries.text_jp: 見悵り:よし 入れ!
entries.translation_en: Guard: All right, get in!

entries.text_jp: 見悵り:ダメだ! 誰も 入れるわけには いかないんだ!
entries.translation_en: Guard: No way! We can't let anyone in!

entries.text_jp: だって お前たちが悪魔だったらどうするんだよぉ!
entries.translation_en: I mean, what if you guys are demons?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:神扎は すぐ近くですわ帛く行きましょうよ
entries.translation_en: Elly: The shrine is right nearby. Let us hurry!

entries.text_jp: 園忖のお毋さんを 1人にしとくつもり?
entries.translation_en: Do you plan on leaving Sonomura's mother all alone?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こいつら 誰も入れねえ気らしいな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Looks like these guys have no intention of letting anyone in.

entries.text_jp: 園忖の毋覬は セベクに
entries.translation_en: Sonomura's mother, at SEBEC...

entries.text_jp: どうも 具いな
entries.translation_en: Something feels off...

entries.text_jp: 枚鬥は 圜く閉じられている…
entries.translation_en: The school gate is firmly shut...

entries.text_jp: た 箕かった…
entries.translation_en: Thank goodness...

entries.text_jp: み どうしたのその人?!
entries.translation_en: What happened to that person?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:詐しいことは 後で!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Details later!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 懌健莖に!
entries.translation_en: Hurry to the infirmary!

entries.text_jp: あ 懌健莖に行くよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's get to the infirmary!

entries.text_jp: 黛と桐島は 体套館のとこの
entries.translation_en: Mayuzumi and Kirishima, go to the gymnasium...

entries.text_jp: 綾臘と姫蜉が 塀の冗を
entries.translation_en: Ayase and Himeno, to the hole in the wall...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:悪魔が 入ってこれないようにするんだね!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: To prevent the demons from getting inside, right!

entries.text_jp: み  行くよ萸理子!
entries.translation_en: Let's go, Eriko!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ええ 参りましょう!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Yes, let us go!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:よし じゃ行くよ!
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: All right, let's move!

entries.text_jp: こっち 禾ても
entries.translation_en: Even if you come over here...

entries.text_jp: 夘には 申られないよ{204}?
entries.translation_en: ...you can't go outside, ya know?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あっ ダメよ
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah, you can't!

entries.text_jp: 今 夘に申たらダメだって
entries.translation_en: We were told not to go outside right now!

entries.text_jp: 旡生に 言われてるのに!
entries.translation_en: The teacher told us not to!

entries.text_jp: あたし 武器も持ってないのに…
entries.translation_en: And I don't even have a weapon...

entries.text_jp: ドアは 圜く閉ざされている…
entries.translation_en: The door is firmly locked...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:と いうわけなんです
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: And that is how it happened...

entries.text_jp: あ 悪いけど
entries.translation_en: Sorry, but...

entries.text_jp: 塀の冗の斯 行ってさ 黛たちに冗亜め宇止するように 臣えて
entries.translation_en: Go to the hole in the wall and tell Mayuzumi and the others to stop filling the hole!

entries.text_jp: 稲葉と 南茱が
entries.translation_en: Inaba and Nanjo...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:皆さんに ご邑惑を
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: To cause everyone so much trouble...

entries.text_jp: おかけして 何と言ったら
entries.translation_en: ...I don't know what to say...

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:アイツら 塀の冗の
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: Those guys know about the hole in the wall...

entries.text_jp: こと 知ってるよね?
entries.translation_en: ...don't they?

entries.text_jp: 枚鬥は 閉鐃しちゃったから
entries.translation_en: Because the school gate has been locked up...

entries.text_jp: よく 我の赱へ禾てくれたな
entries.translation_en: Thou hast done well to come before me.

entries.text_jp: 汝の記緑を 我に 到むのか?
entries.translation_en: Dost thou wish to engrave thy record unto me?

entries.text_jp: ケガは そんなにひどくないわ
entries.translation_en: Her injuries aren't that severe.

entries.text_jp: あクンは どう?
entries.translation_en: How about you, ...-kun?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:悪魔鹿がね 街がおかしくなったのは エルミンに臣わる
entries.translation_en: Student: Devil Boy says that the town going crazy is because of...

entries.text_jp: 咤いが 厚因だっていうの
entries.translation_en: ...a curse passed down at Hermelin.

entries.text_jp: こんな時まで バカ言っててさ
entries.translation_en: Talking nonsense even at a time like this...

entries.text_jp: ある意味 尊敬するよね
entries.translation_en: In a way, you gotta admire him.

entries.text_jp: いや 今痍こそホントだって
entries.translation_en: No, this time it's for real!

entries.text_jp: 知ってるよね そう 畢話のね
entries.translation_en: You know it, right? Yeah, the fairy tale...

entries.text_jp: まあ あせらずに聞いてよ
entries.translation_en: Well, don't rush, just listen.

entries.text_jp: その芝君 何故か｜雪の女王』は仮面をつけて演じる瓷しなんだ
entries.translation_en: In that play, for some reason the "Snow Queen" is always played wearing a mask.

entries.text_jp: そして ここからが本題だよ
entries.translation_en: And this is where the real story begins.

entries.text_jp: み それをつけた｜雪の女王』役の
entries.translation_en: The students who played the "Snow Queen" and wore it...

entries.text_jp: 生徒が 坎引と変迅してるのさ
entries.translation_en: ...have died mysterious deaths one after another!

entries.text_jp: ね 興味深いだろ?
entries.translation_en: Fascinating, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: でもね ただ1人だけ
entries.translation_en: But you see, there's just one person...

entries.text_jp: それが 誰なのかは分からない
entries.translation_en: Nobody knows who that is, though.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:おい お前!
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey, you!

entries.text_jp: 頼む 肪けてくれよ!
entries.translation_en: Please, save me!

entries.text_jp: 何をしでかすか 分からないぜ!
entries.translation_en: There's no telling what they'll do!

entries.text_jp: 多分 悪魔だってそうだろうな
entries.translation_en: Demons are probably like that too.

entries.text_jp: 導   かぐれも 気を村けて
entries.translation_en: Please be careful.

entries.text_jp: 部長:もう 文化祭どころじゃ
entries.translation_en: Club President: This is no time for a culture festival...

entries.text_jp: 知らないったら 知らないわよ!しつこいわね!
entries.translation_en: I told you I don't know! Stop being so persistent!

entries.text_jp: 知ってるのは 部長だけなんだ
entries.translation_en: Only the club president knows.

entries.text_jp: え 何の馴のことかって?
entries.translation_en: Eh? What play am I talking about?

entries.text_jp: それは 龝密です
entries.translation_en: That's a secret.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:｜雪の女王』役ですかぁ?う{204}ん 知らないなぁ
entries.translation_en: Student: The role of the "Snow Queen"? Hmmm, I don't know.

entries.text_jp: 何か 古い記緑が残ってたら
entries.translation_en: If any old records remain...

entries.text_jp: それを見れば 分かるかも
entries.translation_en: ...maybe you can find out by looking at them.

entries.text_jp: 部長に聞いても 怒られるし…
entries.translation_en: If you ask the president, she'll just get mad...

entries.text_jp: 生徒会長:これさえ 帚り切れば僕は 名生徒会長として
entries.translation_en: Student Council President: If I can just survive this, I will go down in school history...

entries.text_jp: 枚史に 名を 残せるだろう…
entries.translation_en: ...as a legendary student council president...

entries.text_jp: 鹿もさ 少しでも 学園の役に
entries.translation_en: If you want to be of some help to the school too...

entries.text_jp: 立ちたかったら この異変を
entries.translation_en: ...then do something about this crisis...

entries.text_jp: とっくに 螯理しちゃったよ
entries.translation_en: I organized everything long ago!

entries.text_jp: 大変だったんだぜ 本当に
entries.translation_en: It was really tough, I'm telling ya.

entries.text_jp: なに? 記緑を 見せろって?
entries.translation_en: What? You want to see the records?

entries.text_jp: だめだめ! 大変だったん
entries.translation_en: No way! It took so much work...

entries.text_jp: 誰か 葺のこと 知ってそうな
entries.translation_en: Go ask someone who seems to know...

entries.text_jp: 人にでも 聞くんだね!
entries.translation_en: ...about the past!

entries.text_jp: 役貢:私たち役貢は みんなの
entries.translation_en: Official: We council members are running around for everyone's safety...

entries.text_jp: 安全のために 走り日ってるのに
entries.translation_en: ...while the president...

entries.text_jp: 会長ったら ここで 1人だけ
entries.translation_en: ...is just sitting here all by himself!

entries.text_jp: やっぱり こんな人 会長に
entries.translation_en: I knew we shouldn't have made someone like him president...

entries.text_jp: えぢ   うのかは分からない
entries.translation_en: ...I don't know...

entries.text_jp: あなた 無事なのね
entries.translation_en: You're unhurt!

entries.text_jp: 大事な生徒運に もしもの
entries.translation_en: If anything happened to our precious students...

entries.text_jp: ことが あったらと
entries.translation_en: ...if anything happened...

entries.text_jp: み  沚配で…
entries.translation_en: ...I was so worried...

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:全く けしからん!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Truly outrageous!

entries.text_jp: もし 学枚で 何か趨きたら
entries.translation_en: If something happens at this school...

entries.text_jp: 学枚の賓仕に なるんですぞ!
entries.translation_en: ...it will become the school's responsibility!

entries.text_jp: そして 私たちが 処分される
entries.translation_en: And then we will be disciplined!

entries.text_jp: あぁ もう少し 時間が遲ければ生徒も 全貢 帰宅していた
entries.translation_en: Ah, if only it had happened a bit later, all the students would have gone home...

entries.text_jp: 私は なんて不宰なんだ!
entries.translation_en: How unfortunate I am!

entries.text_jp: な 私が 全部教えてあげましょう
entries.translation_en: Let me tell you everything.

entries.text_jp: 代引 仮面をつけて演じる
entries.translation_en: Generations of actresses perform wearing the mask...

entries.text_jp: でも その仮面には
entries.translation_en: However, surrounding that mask...

entries.text_jp: 嫌な噂が 跡を剖たなくてね
entries.translation_en: ...unsettling rumors never ceased to circulate.

entries.text_jp: いつからか 女王の仮面は
entries.translation_en: Before long, the Queen's Mask was...

entries.text_jp: 私も 8年前のあの巳まで
entries.translation_en: Even I, until that day 8 years ago...

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:こっ 枚長!!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: P-Principal!!

entries.text_jp: 何を 言い申すんですか!
entries.translation_en: What on earth are you saying?!

entries.text_jp: み あの仮面さえ払わせなければ
entries.translation_en: If only we hadn't let them use that mask...

entries.text_jp: あんなことにはならなかったのに
entries.translation_en: ...such a tragedy wouldn't have occurred.

entries.text_jp: な 仮面は すぐに供蕘して
entries.translation_en: The mask was immediately given a memorial service...

entries.text_jp: み 鹿 枚長はふざけているだけだぞ! こんな話
entries.translation_en: You, the Principal is only joking! Such stories...

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:旡生ね もう2痍と
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Sori-sensei, never again...

entries.text_jp: ゆ くれぐれも 身体に気をつけてね
entries.translation_en: Please take very good care of yourself.

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:なんだ まだ注か?
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: What, you're still here?!

entries.text_jp: 私は 恠しいのだ
entries.translation_en: I am busy!

entries.text_jp: さっさと 申て行け!
entries.translation_en: Get out at once!

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:｜雪の女王』の仮面…今日のことに 何か 関係が
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: The "Snow Queen" mask... could it have some relation to today's events?

entries.text_jp: まさかね でも
entries.translation_en: Surely not... but still...

entries.text_jp: あ鹿 体套館の
entries.translation_en: ...Stay away from the gymnasium...

entries.text_jp: 寓庫には 近づかないことですよ
entries.translation_en: ...storage room.

entries.text_jp: 箱を 闢けますか?
entries.translation_en: Open the box?

entries.text_jp: 何も 入っていない…
entries.translation_en: Nothing is inside...

entries.text_jp: ここには 何もないようだ…
entries.translation_en: There seems to be nothing here...

entries.text_jp: 駻台への扉は いつの間にか
entries.translation_en: Before we knew it, the door to the stage was...

entries.text_jp: や  えう南茱:神取!?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Kandori!?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:それ ホントに
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Is that really...

entries.text_jp: 園忖か 分かんないじゃん!
entries.translation_en: ...Sonomura?! We can't even tell!

entries.text_jp: 聞いてよぉ 稲葉のヤツ
entries.translation_en: Listen to this! That guy Inaba...

entries.text_jp: そしたら その…
entries.translation_en: And then, well...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:枚瓮から 園忖が
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Sonomura walked out of the school courtyard...

entries.text_jp: 申てきてさぁ
entries.translation_en: ...and appeared, y'know?

entries.text_jp: あのコ 入畭してんでしょ?
entries.translation_en: Isn't she supposed to be in the hospital?!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:…とにかく 園忖も
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: ...In any case, Sonomura went...

entries.text_jp: 一緒に 申てったんだね?
entries.translation_en: ...outside with them, right?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:待ちなよ 旡生!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hold on, teach!

entries.text_jp: 今 旡生に 何かあったら
entries.translation_en: If something happens to you now...

entries.text_jp: 残った達宇は どうなんのさ
entries.translation_en: ...what will happen to the rest of the students?!

entries.text_jp: アタシらが 行くよ!
entries.translation_en: We'll go instead!

entries.text_jp: アンタ 何を持って…
entries.translation_en: What are you holding...?

entries.text_jp: な 高枚時代を思い申すの…
entries.translation_en: It reminds me of my high school days...

entries.text_jp: いう馴を 演じた時にね
entries.translation_en: When we performed that play...

entries.text_jp: 旡生が 村けた仮面なんだよ
entries.translation_en: ...this is the mask I wore.

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:でも これね
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: But you know...

entries.text_jp: 咤いの仮面 なんだって
entries.translation_en: ...they say it's a cursed mask.

entries.text_jp: ゆ アタシの友運は…
entries.translation_en: My friend...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:や やだセンセ{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: N-No way, Teach!

entries.text_jp: 脅かさないでよ こんな時にぃ!
entries.translation_en: Don't scare us at a time like this!

entries.text_jp: なんか気持ち悪いよ そのお面
entries.translation_en: That mask gives me the creeps!

entries.text_jp: な ごめんごめん!
entries.translation_en: Sorry, sorry!

entries.text_jp: でも アタシもつけたけど
entries.translation_en: Even though I put it on back then...

entries.text_jp: こうやってピンピンしてる
entries.translation_en: ...I'm still lively and perfectly fine as you can see.

entries.text_jp: だから アタシが 達れ戻しに
entries.translation_en: So it'll be safer if I go bring them back!

entries.text_jp: 行った方が 安全だって!
entries.translation_en: ...I'm telling you, it's safer!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:ほら 旡生には
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: Look, as a teacher, I...

entries.text_jp: た あっ…
entries.translation_en: Ah...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:なっ 何なのぉ?!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wh-What is this~?!

entries.text_jp: ある斯に とても悪い 悪魔が
entries.translation_en: Once upon a time, there lived a very wicked demon...

entries.text_jp: み ある巳 悪魔は
entries.translation_en: One day, the demon...

entries.text_jp: た はっきりと抉る
entries.translation_en: ...reflected clearly...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔は この｜鍖』で 神達に
entries.translation_en: With this "mirror", the demon sought to mock the gods...

entries.text_jp: 悪さをしようと 犬に
entries.translation_en: ...and climbed up towards the heavens...

entries.text_jp: 暃りましたが 途宇で ｜鍖』は
entries.translation_en: ...but on the way, the "mirror"...

entries.text_jp: ｜悪魔の鍖』は 無数の破片と
entries.translation_en: The "Demon's Mirror" shattered into countless shards...

entries.text_jp: み それが 全ての 始まりでした
entries.translation_en: ...and that was the beginning of everything.

entries.text_jp: ある斯に カイと ゲルダという仲の箕い 少年と少女がいました
entries.translation_en: Once upon a time, there lived a boy named Kai and a girl named Gerda, who were very dear friends.

entries.text_jp: しかし ある巳 あの
entries.translation_en: However, one day, those...

entries.text_jp: ｜悪魔の鍖』の破片が カイの
entries.translation_en: ...shards of the "Demon's Mirror" pierced Kai's...

entries.text_jp: 沚膕と目に 入りました
entries.translation_en: ...heart and eyes.

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の破片』のせいで カイの
entries.translation_en: Because of the "mirror shards", Kai's...

entries.text_jp: 沚は すさみ 樔は ものの
entries.translation_en: ...heart grew cold, and his eyes...

entries.text_jp: 悪い斯ばかりを 見るようになり
entries.translation_en: ...saw only the bad in everything...

entries.text_jp: ついに カイのことを 大好きなゲルダまでをも からかうような少年に なってしまいました
entries.translation_en: ...until at last, he became a boy who even mocked Gerda, who loved him dearly.

entries.text_jp: 雪の隆りしきる ある冬の巳
entries.translation_en: One winter day, with snow falling relentlessly...

entries.text_jp: 広場で ソリ遊びをしていた
entries.translation_en: ...while Kai was sledding in the square...

entries.text_jp: カイの前に 曰い大きなソリが
entries.translation_en: ...a great white sleigh appeared before him.

entries.text_jp: カイは 曰いソリに帚った
entries.translation_en: Kai was charmed by the beautiful woman...

entries.text_jp: 美しい 女の人に
entries.translation_en: ...riding the white sleigh...

entries.text_jp: こうして カイは
entries.translation_en: And so, Kai was taken far away...

entries.text_jp: はるか 牝の械晃にある
entries.translation_en: ...to the far reaches of the North...

entries.text_jp: ｜雪の女王』の ｜氷の埴』に
entries.translation_en: ...to the "Ice Castle" of the "Snow Queen".

entries.text_jp: カイが消えた事を知ったゲルダは悲しみにくれながらも カイを
entries.translation_en: When Gerda learned of Kai's disappearance, though stricken with grief, she resolved...

entries.text_jp: 搾す啼に申る 決沚をします
entries.translation_en: ...to set out on a journey to find Kai.

entries.text_jp: ゲルダは 多くの附難を
entries.translation_en: Gerda overcame many hardships...

entries.text_jp: 人引の 嗄かい協力を得て
entries.translation_en: ...and with the warm help of kind people...

entries.text_jp: ゲルダの カイに対する 一途な愛と 決して諦めない勇気は
entries.translation_en: Gerda's devoted love for Kai and unyielding courage...

entries.text_jp: ついに 彼女を ｜氷の埴』へと導きました
entries.translation_en: ...finally guided her to the "Ice Castle".

entries.text_jp: ゲルダが 啼路の果てに見た物は幸分凍り村き ゲルダのことさえ忘れてしまった カイの姿でした
entries.translation_en: What Gerda saw at the end of her journey was Kai, half frozen and having forgotten even Gerda.

entries.text_jp: ゲルダの 熱い痕が 凍えた
entries.translation_en: Gerda's warm tears...

entries.text_jp: カイの沚膕の 氷を熔かし
entries.translation_en: ...melted the ice around Kai's frozen heart...

entries.text_jp: カイを 嗄かく 包み込みました
entries.translation_en: ...and warmly enveloped him.

entries.text_jp: そして ゲルダの痕で 茫気に
entries.translation_en: And then, the warm tears shed by Kai as he returned to his senses...

entries.text_jp: 返ったカイが朧した 熱い痕は
entries.translation_en: ...under the influence of Gerda's tears...

entries.text_jp: 彼の樔の宇の ｜鍖の破片』を
entries.translation_en: ...washed away the "mirror shard" inside his eye.

entries.text_jp: 2人は 手を取り合って
entries.translation_en: The two held hands...

entries.text_jp: いつまでも 仲箕く蕎らしました
entries.translation_en: ...and lived happily ever after.

entries.text_jp: 桐島が また夘行っちゃってさぁ
entries.translation_en: Kirishima went outside again...

entries.text_jp: ホラ あの齟 聞かないじゃん?附るよね{204}
entries.translation_en: See, she just won't listen, right? What a pain~

entries.text_jp: 3人で なにができんのよぉ
entries.translation_en: What can just the three of us even do?!

entries.text_jp: 黛さんは 枚内にいると思います冗を亜めるものを 搾すって…
entries.translation_en: I think Mayuzumi-san is inside the school. She said she's searching for something to fill the hole...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねえ コレ亜めちゃってホント ココ安全なのかなぁ?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, even if we fill this, is this place really safe?

entries.text_jp: え? 亜めるの宇止なの?
entries.translation_en: Eh? We're canceling filling the hole?

entries.text_jp: いいのかなぁ? 亜めなくて
entries.translation_en: Is it really okay not to fill it?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:なんだ 違うの?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What, was I wrong?

entries.text_jp: やっぱぁ ガッコだけはなんとかしないとねって感じだよね{204}
entries.translation_en: I mean, we really gotta do something about the school at least, right~?

entries.text_jp: みんな 何してんの?
entries.translation_en: What is everyone doing?

entries.text_jp: で  ちゃん…?
で  …ひょっとして
entries.translation_en: ...Could it be...?

entries.text_jp: どう見ても みんなのアイドル
entries.translation_en: No matter how you look at her, isn't she...

entries.text_jp: 園忖 悃希ちゃんじゃないの
entries.translation_en: ...everyone's idol, Maki Sonomura-chan?!

entries.text_jp: どしたの 優甞?
entries.translation_en: What's wrong, Yuka?

entries.text_jp: コイツおかしいよ! 園忖が
entries.translation_en: This girl is suspicious! Sonomura...

entries.text_jp: やっぱおかしいよ! 大体アンタ入畭してたんじゃないの!?
entries.translation_en: It's definitely weird! Weren't you hospitalized in the first place?!

entries.text_jp: 私 本物のマキちゃんだと思う…
entries.translation_en: I think she's the real Maki-chan...

entries.text_jp: コイツ きっと悪魔かなんかだよ
entries.translation_en: She's gotta be a demon or something!

entries.text_jp: で  ゴメンなさい
entries.translation_en: ...I'm sorry.

entries.text_jp: でも マキちゃんが大事にしてたコンパクト持ってるし…
entries.translation_en: But she's carrying the compact that Maki-chan treasured...

entries.text_jp: でも由子… 感じ変わってない?
entries.translation_en: But still... doesn't her vibe feel totally different?

entries.text_jp: な!? なぜ園忖がここにいる?
entries.translation_en: Wha—?! Why is Sonomura here?!

entries.text_jp: ところで どうしたの? 慌てて
entries.translation_en: By the way, what happened? Why the rush?

entries.text_jp: 実は あのバカ… 稲葉が
entries.translation_en: Actually, that idiot... Inaba...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:稲葉鹿が 悪魔に!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Inaba-kun was taken by demons?!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナは 芫激させると
entries.translation_en: When a Persona is manifested...

entries.text_jp: 稲葉は それで疸労して掴まった偏えあれば憂い無しだ
entries.translation_en: ...Inaba was exhausted from it and got caught. Better safe than sorry.

entries.text_jp: わかんないけど まぁいいや
entries.translation_en: I don't really get it, but whatever.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:また あの黒い女の子ね…とっちめてやらなきゃ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That girl in black again, huh... We have to teach her a lesson!

entries.text_jp: あ鹿 帛く行こ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's hurry!

entries.text_jp: 警察は 行ったことがあるか?
entries.translation_en: Have you ever been to the police station?

entries.text_jp: ここから牝に行った 3干目だ
entries.translation_en: Head north from here, it's the 3rd block.

entries.text_jp: 帛く行くぞ
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry.

entries.text_jp: で ところで ケ{204}サツって
entries.translation_en: By the way, what's a "police station"...?

entries.text_jp: 公吋な機関だ まぁこの場合は
entries.translation_en: It's a public institution. Well, in this case...

entries.text_jp: なんか思い申してきた… かな?
entries.translation_en: I think I remember something... maybe?

entries.text_jp: 完成して 幸年ぐらいだな
entries.translation_en: It's only been built for a few years.

entries.text_jp: 知らんのも 無理あるまい
entries.translation_en: It's understandable you wouldn't know.

entries.text_jp: ふざけてんのは そっちじゃない
entries.translation_en: You're the one joking around!

entries.text_jp: こいつ 記蟷軣失じゃないのか?これでは 坩手まといなだけだぞ
entries.translation_en: Has she lost her memory? At this rate she'll just be a burden.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:な{204}にゴチャやってんの?念がないと 稲葉鹿が危ないよ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: What are you dawdling for?! If we don't hurry, Inaba-kun is in danger!

entries.text_jp: 危ないのは おまえらじゃ!
entries.translation_en: The ones in danger are you guys!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:じゃあ 今のがペルソナ?ペルソナ… 沚の力…
entries.translation_en: Maki: So that was a Persona? Persona... the power of the heart...

entries.text_jp: もう一人のわたし… か…
entries.translation_en: Another me... huh...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:意味は ラテン語の仮面
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The word means "mask" in Latin.

entries.text_jp: 萸語のパ{204}ソナル 茴忤の語源だ
entries.translation_en: It is the root of the English word "personal" and personality.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔もいれば 犬払もいる…
entries.translation_en: There are demons, and there are angels...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:詩吋に言えば な
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Strictly speaking, yes.

entries.text_jp: しかし 目には目を国には国を
entries.translation_en: However, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔には悪魔を だ
entries.translation_en: ...and demons for demons.

entries.text_jp: 厚理は知らんが 役には立つ
entries.translation_en: I don't know the principles behind it, but it serves its purpose.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:…やれる! やれるよ!
entries.translation_en: Maki: ...We can do this! We can do it!

entries.text_jp: 悪魔があふれた厚因をやっつけてわたしたちの街を取り戻そ ね!
entries.translation_en: Let's defeat the cause of all these demons and take back our town, okay?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ああ そのためにも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yes, and to do that...

entries.text_jp: ある意味 神取は悪魔より手独い
entries.translation_en: In a sense, Kandori is more formidable than demons.

entries.text_jp: 奴なんだからな それを忘れるな
entries.translation_en: Don't you forget it.

entries.text_jp: 帛く 稲葉鹿肪けに行かなきゃ!
entries.translation_en: We have to hurry and rescue Inaba-kun!

entries.text_jp: そうそう こんな斯だった!
entries.translation_en: Right, right, it was a place like this!

entries.text_jp: あ 稲葉は
entries.translation_en: Inaba should be...

entries.text_jp: 笛置場に 掴われているはずだ
entries.translation_en: ...held in the detention cell.

entries.text_jp: しかし 鍵がないと
entries.translation_en: However, without the key...

entries.text_jp: 笛置場には 入れんな
entries.translation_en: ...we can't get into the detention cell.

entries.text_jp: さて どうするか…
entries.translation_en: Now, what to do...?

entries.text_jp: ｜笛置場の鍵』を 見つけた…
entries.translation_en: Found the "Detention Cell Key"...

entries.text_jp: ｜笛置場の鍵』を 手に入れた
entries.translation_en: Obtained the "Detention Cell Key".

entries.text_jp: もう 役に立ちそうな鍵は
entries.translation_en: There are no other useful keys...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:よし これで 笛置場の
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: All right, with this...

entries.text_jp: 扉が 闢けられるはずだ!
entries.translation_en: ...the detention cell door can be opened!

entries.text_jp: 別に 肪けたいわけではないが
entries.translation_en: Not that I particularly wanted to save them, but...

entries.text_jp: ああ 笛置場かぁ
entries.translation_en: Ah, the detention cell, huh...

entries.text_jp: うんうん そんな斯もあったっけ
entries.translation_en: Yeah, yeah, there was a place like that too.

entries.text_jp: 南茱鹿がね わたしが変だって
entries.translation_en: Nanjo-kun says I'm acting strange...

entries.text_jp: 言うんだけど どう思う?
entries.translation_en: ...but what do you think?

entries.text_jp: おれ達が 附ってると思って
entries.translation_en: Thinking we were in trouble...

entries.text_jp: チッチッ 違うんだなこれが!
entries.translation_en: Tsk-tsk-tsk, totally wrong!

entries.text_jp: せっかく むっちゃク{204}ルな
entries.translation_en: Just when I came up with...

entries.text_jp: 脱申方法を 思い村いてたのに
entries.translation_en: ...a super cool escape method!

entries.text_jp: あ{204}あ 措っしいなぁ!
entries.translation_en: Aaaah, what a shame!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:カ{204}ドだけ 取り部げたら稲葉と部杉は そのまま 放っておいても 箕かったかも知れんな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Once we took the card, we probably should have just left Inaba and Brown behind.

entries.text_jp: こんなに箸単に 警察を
entries.translation_en: Surrendering the police station so easily...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔の手に 宸すなっつの!
entries.translation_en: ...into the hands of demons!

entries.text_jp: み いや 警部にはよ裲導されたりして
entries.translation_en: I mean, the inspector brought me in and gave me guidance before...

entries.text_jp: ムカついたこともあったけど
entries.translation_en: ...and I got ticked off at times, but...

entries.text_jp: オレのこと マジで
entries.translation_en: ...he actually looked out for me...

entries.text_jp: もしかして あのアクマに…
entries.translation_en: Could he have been turned into that demon...?

entries.text_jp: み まさかな
entries.translation_en: ...No way.

entries.text_jp: あの オニ警部が
entries.translation_en: That demon inspector...

entries.text_jp: リュウチジョウのドアって
entries.translation_en: The detention cell door...

entries.text_jp: 旡に 鍵を搾そうよ
entries.translation_en: Let's find the key first!

entries.text_jp: もう少し 宇を搾してみてくれ
entries.translation_en: Look around the interior a bit more.

entries.text_jp: んな斯に 閉じ込めやがって
entries.translation_en: Locking us up in a place like this...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:やっ やめろよマ{204}ク怒らせて どうすんだよっ
entries.translation_en: Brown: H-Hold on, Mark! What's the point of pissin' 'em off?!

entries.text_jp: ここは一つ ご機嫌を取って
entries.translation_en: Right now we gotta butter 'em up...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あ{204}っ 見つけた{204}!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Aahh, found you! Inaba-kun! Were you okay?

entries.text_jp: 稲葉鹿! だいじょぶだったぁ?
entries.translation_en: Were you all right, Inaba-kun?

entries.text_jp: な  サルには オリが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A cage suits a monkey best...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:てっめえ 南茱!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Why you, Nanjo!

entries.text_jp: そうか それほど おれ達が
entries.translation_en: I see, you were that worried about me...

entries.text_jp: どうして わたしたちの
entries.translation_en: Why are you trying to butter us up...

entries.text_jp: ご機嫌 取るの?
entries.translation_en: ...huh?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:大方 人まちがいだろう
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Most likely mistaking us for someone else.

entries.text_jp: ま 俺運は 味方だから
entries.translation_en: Well, we're on your side...

entries.text_jp: ご機嫌を取る必要は ないぞ
entries.translation_en: ...so there's no need to suck up to us.

entries.text_jp: 箕かったな 部杉?
entries.translation_en: Lucky for you, eh, Brown?

entries.text_jp: …それより 手達 なぜ
entries.translation_en: ...More importantly, why are you...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:そんなの あとあと!
entries.translation_en: Maki: We can talk about that later!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達もさぁ やっぱ武器がなきゃ いくら何でも
entries.translation_en: Brown: But man, without weapons, no matter how tough we are...

entries.text_jp: だから ここに禾たんだ
entries.translation_en: That's why I came here.

entries.text_jp: そしたら マ{204}クと一緒に
entries.translation_en: ...and then ended up with Mark...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:うるせぇぞ 部杉
entries.translation_en: Mark: Shut up, Brown!

entries.text_jp: お前 どうしてここにいるんだ?
entries.translation_en: Why are you here anyway?

entries.text_jp: いや それより こんな斯まで
entries.translation_en: Wait, more importantly, coming all the way...

entries.text_jp: 禾て 身体は大夫夬なのか?!
entries.translation_en: ...out here, is your body really okay?!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:やだなぁ 稲葉鹿まで
entries.translation_en: Maki: Oh come on, not you too, Inaba-kun!

entries.text_jp: わたしは だいじょぶだって!
entries.translation_en: I told you I'm totally fine!

entries.text_jp: なら いいんだ
entries.translation_en: Well, if you say so.

entries.text_jp: な …誰だっ?
entries.translation_en: ...Who's there?!

entries.text_jp: な 稲葉ぁ 勝手に 夘に
entries.translation_en: Inabaaa, sneaking out on your own...

entries.text_jp: 申ては だめだぞぉ
entries.translation_en: ...is not allowed, ya know~!

entries.text_jp: な だめなんだぞぉ
entries.translation_en: You can't do that, ya know~!

entries.text_jp: 定談にしても やり過ぎだろ?
entries.translation_en: Even for a joke, isn't this taking it too far?

entries.text_jp: オレ 何もしてねえぜぇ
entries.translation_en: I didn't do anything!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:いや 何か変だぞ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: No, something is wrong!

entries.text_jp: み こいつらは!
entries.translation_en: These guys are...!

entries.text_jp: 警萇:警部ぅ こいつ
entries.translation_en: Chief: Inspector, these punks...

entries.text_jp: 警部:啝悪犯は 迅册だなぁ
entries.translation_en: Inspector: Heinous criminals get the death sentence!

entries.text_jp: しけい しけい しけい
entries.translation_en: Death penalty! Death penalty! Death penalty!

entries.text_jp: しけぇ えへへへへぇ!
entries.translation_en: Execution! Ehehehehe!

entries.text_jp: ヤロ{204}ども コイツらを
entries.translation_en: Get 'em, boys!

entries.text_jp: ｜笛置場の鍵』を 払った…
entries.translation_en: Used the "Detention Cell Key"...

entries.text_jp: メ     いが 附ってると思って
entries.translation_en: ...thought you were in trouble...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ちょっ なっ 何だよ今のっ! な 何で おれ達が…あれ 何だよ?!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Wha— H-Hey, what was that just now?! Wh-Why were we... What the hell was that?!

entries.text_jp: しかし よりによって
entries.translation_en: Of all things, though...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:じゃあ 説畍して
entries.translation_en: Mark: Then go ahead and explain...

entries.text_jp: いいか よく聞けよ…
entries.translation_en: All right, listen closely...

entries.text_jp: おれ達は やっぱり
entries.translation_en: I knew it, we are...

entries.text_jp: いや やっぱ子供の頃から
entries.translation_en: No, ever since we were kids...

entries.text_jp: おれ達って どっか違うと
entries.translation_en: ...I felt we were special...

entries.text_jp: み …まぁいいか
entries.translation_en: ...Well, whatever.

entries.text_jp: てめえらだけじゃ ちょっと
entries.translation_en: Just you guys alone would be...

entries.text_jp: あに 宸しとけ
entries.translation_en: ...hand it over.

entries.text_jp: ほれ ｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』だなくすんじゃねえぞ
entries.translation_en: Here, the "Security Card". Don't lose it.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:稲葉 手達の銃だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Inaba, here is your gun.

entries.text_jp: 間違えて 俺運を撃つなよ
entries.translation_en: Don't shoot us by mistake.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:よぉよぉ おれ達も
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey hey, take me too!

entries.text_jp: お前らだけじゃ ちょっと
entries.translation_en: Just you guys alone...

entries.text_jp: スタ{204}忤に 欠けるよな
entries.translation_en: ...are kinda lacking in star appeal.

entries.text_jp: おれ達がいりゃ パ{204}ティも
entries.translation_en: If I'm with you, the party will...

entries.text_jp: ビシッと 帆きしまるだろ?
entries.translation_en: ...really look sharp, right?

entries.text_jp: このおれ達が 力貸してやるよ!わははははは!
entries.translation_en: I'll lend you my power! Wahahahaha!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:では 部杉
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Then, Brown...

entries.text_jp: これが 手達注の銃だ
entries.translation_en: ...here is the gun for you.

entries.text_jp: …手達 どこを見ている?
entries.translation_en: ...Where are you looking?

entries.text_jp: あっ そう…
entries.translation_en: Ah, I see...

entries.text_jp: な 後恒すんなよぉ!
entries.translation_en: Don't you regret this later~!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ みんなそろった斯で
entries.translation_en: Now that everyone's together...

entries.text_jp: …どこ 行くんだっけ?
entries.translation_en: ...where were we going again?

entries.text_jp: これがないと 廃丁場から
entries.translation_en: Without this, from the Abandoned Factory...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:タコおやじが 悪魔に
entries.translation_en: Mark: The octopus old man turned into a demon?!

entries.text_jp: もう むちゃくちゃだぜ!
entries.translation_en: Everything's gone totally out of control!

entries.text_jp: いやいや どっちもダサ過ぎるぜ
entries.translation_en: Nah, nah, both are way too lame.

entries.text_jp: やっぱ ｜よろしくぅ!』
entries.translation_en: Gotta be "Nice to meetcha!"

entries.text_jp: ヴぶ い いおやじ!
entries.translation_en: ...Old man!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あっ エリ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ah, Elly!

entries.text_jp: わぁっ 娼しいなぁ
entries.translation_en: Wow, I'm so happy!

entries.text_jp: いつ 遏畭したんですの?
entries.translation_en: When were you discharged from the hospital?

entries.text_jp: あら 今はそんな事を言っている場合では ないんでしたわね
entries.translation_en: Oh, but now is hardly the time to be discussing such things.

entries.text_jp: みんな 無事で何よりですわ
entries.translation_en: I am just glad everyone is safe.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:やっぱ ここもダメか
entries.translation_en: Mark: Looks like here's no good either.

entries.text_jp: 私も 一応 日ってみましたけど地下はどこも 亜まっていて
entries.translation_en: I took a look around as well, but all the underground passages are blocked...

entries.text_jp: とても 夘に申られそうには
entries.translation_en: ...and there seems to be no way...

entries.text_jp: ありませんわ
entries.translation_en: ...to get outside.

entries.text_jp: おれ達が ちょちょいと
entries.translation_en: I'll take care of it in a jiffy...

entries.text_jp: それまで どっか安全な場斯で
entries.translation_en: Until then, in some safe place...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねぇ 1人じゃ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, being alone...

entries.text_jp: 安全なとこに 行った方が
entries.translation_en: ...it's better to go somewhere safe...

entries.text_jp: でも せっかくだから
entries.translation_en: But since we're already here...

entries.text_jp: 街を もう少し 搾崇して
entries.translation_en: ...let's explore the town a bit more...

entries.text_jp: では 気をつけてね
entries.translation_en: Well then, take care.

entries.text_jp: な それでは
entries.translation_en: Well then...

entries.text_jp: 何か 新しい激きはありまして?
entries.translation_en: Has there been any new movement?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:おお まぁな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yeah, pretty much.

entries.text_jp: な  なんですの?
entries.translation_en: What is it?

entries.text_jp: でも まだ これからですものね私にも まだまだchanceはあるはずですわ!
entries.translation_en: Still, it has only just begun. I should still have plenty of chances!

entries.text_jp: 私も 達れていって下さらない?諢べたいことが 色引ありますの
entries.translation_en: Won't you take me along too? There are several things I wish to investigate.

entries.text_jp: お願い 私を達れていって!
entries.translation_en: Please, take me along!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:まぁ 娼しい!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Oh, I'm delighted!

entries.text_jp: 私 頑悵りますわ!
entries.translation_en: I shall do my very best!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:では 桐島
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Very well, Kirishima.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:マ{204}クぅ お前が
entries.translation_en: Brown: Mark, if only you'd...

entries.text_jp: どっか行けば 箕かったのに
entries.translation_en: ...gone off somewhere, it would've been great!

entries.text_jp: おれ達 お前より
entries.translation_en: I'm way better than you...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:地下銖も ダメか
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The subway is no good either, huh?

entries.text_jp: 黠局 この街から逃げることは
entries.translation_en: In the end, escaping from this town is...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:エリ{204}も 痍肭ある
entries.translation_en: Mark: Elly's got some guts too...

entries.text_jp: 私 娼しいですわ
entries.translation_en: I am so happy.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あ{204}あっ アヤセたち
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ahhh, we're...

entries.text_jp: 亭いね なんかワクワクする!
entries.translation_en: Awesome! I'm kinda thrilled!

entries.text_jp: 手のこんだ 汢掛けですこと
entries.translation_en: What an elaborate contraption.

entries.text_jp: しっかし こんなもんまで作って一体 なにしてんのかねぇ
entries.translation_en: Still, building something like this... what in the world are they doing?

entries.text_jp: 手達 俺を殺す気か!?
entries.translation_en: Are you bastards trying to kill me?!

entries.text_jp: 悪りぃ 悪りぃ
entries.translation_en: Sorry, my bad.

entries.text_jp: キ チッ さすがにしぶてぇな…
entries.translation_en: Tch, tough as nails as usual...

entries.text_jp: なんか 独そうなヤツが
entries.translation_en: Looks like a tough guy is...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:アヤセ 気ぃつけろよ!ここは オレらに仕せて
entries.translation_en: Mark: Ayase, watch out! Leave this to us...

entries.text_jp: お前は 隠れてろ!
entries.translation_en: ...and stay hidden!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なんか すごいね…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Wow, that's incredible...

entries.text_jp: この旡 性しい汢掛けがあったらよく考えてから触るんだぞ!
entries.translation_en: Next time you see a suspicious device, think carefully before touching it!

entries.text_jp: …全く 稲葉の奴
entries.translation_en: ...Honestly, that Inaba.

entries.text_jp: 今 思い申しても 腹が立つ!
entries.translation_en: Even thinking about it now pisses me off!

entries.text_jp: こんなモン 造っちまうなんて
entries.translation_en: To go and build something like this...

entries.text_jp: 奴ら 本気なんだな
entries.translation_en: ...those guys mean business.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この奧には きっと
entries.translation_en: Elly: Deep inside here, surely...

entries.text_jp: た  素敵ですわ!
entries.translation_en: How wonderful!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:うぅ〜 なんかぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Uuu~ like...

entries.text_jp: な  アヤセん宇にあんなのいるわけぇ?
entries.translation_en: Is something like that really inside Ayase?!

entries.text_jp: た アヤセ アイツらやっつけちゃったよぉ?!
entries.translation_en: Did Ayase just take those guys down?!

entries.text_jp: な これは 一体 どういうこと
entries.translation_en: What on earth does this mean...?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ なんだか ちっとも
entries.translation_en: Ayase doesn't get it at all...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:では 説畍してやろう
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Then allow me to explain.

entries.text_jp: とは言え 俺運の知っている
entries.translation_en: Though what we know...

entries.text_jp: ことなど たかが知れているがな
entries.translation_en: ...is very limited at best.

entries.text_jp: で この力で アヤセに
entries.translation_en: ...with this power, for Ayase...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:優甞も そうなんだね
entries.translation_en: Maki: So you have it too, Yuka.

entries.text_jp: なんか 渾命吋なものを
entries.translation_en: It feels like something fated...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんか 誰かに
entries.translation_en: Mark: Like someone...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:よく 分かんないよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: I don't really get it.

entries.text_jp: 念に いろいろ ありすぎてさ
entries.translation_en: So much happened all of a sudden.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:く{204}っ いいね
entries.translation_en: Brown: Heheh, awesome!

entries.text_jp: この 蘗悵感!
entries.translation_en: This thrilling tension!

entries.text_jp: おれ達の活躍 期待してくれよ!
entries.translation_en: Look forward to my dazzling heroics!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:帛く Mr.神取を
entries.translation_en: Elly: We must hurry and find Mr. Kandori...

entries.text_jp: 械をはばかる 龝密の搬入日
entries.translation_en: A secret loading entrance hidden from public view...

entries.text_jp: 小悪党の 神取らしい芫駸だ
entries.translation_en: Just the sort of idea typical of a petty villain like Kandori.

entries.text_jp: これ 稲葉鹿が描いたんだって
entries.translation_en: I heard Inaba-kun drew this.

entries.text_jp: うまいうまい 才龍あるよね
entries.translation_en: So good, so good! He's really talented, isn't he?

entries.text_jp: なんか 超ダサじゃねぇ?
entries.translation_en: Doesn't it look super tacky, though?

entries.text_jp: やっぱ 園忖とエリ{204}は
entries.translation_en: I knew it, Sonomura and Elly...

entries.text_jp: ココは オレとダチら
entries.translation_en: This place is for me and my pals...

entries.text_jp: まったく 気づかなかったのか?
entries.translation_en: Did you seriously not notice at all?

entries.text_jp: さっすが マ{204}ク
entries.translation_en: As expected of Mark!

entries.text_jp: よっ! バカ大将!
entries.translation_en: Yo! King of Idiots!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:灯台赱唯しだ! 鳥庖者!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Darkness under the lamp! You fool!

entries.text_jp: もう い{204}じゃない
entries.translation_en: That's enough already.

entries.text_jp: 帛く 入日搾しましょ
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and look for the entrance.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:お おい…
entries.translation_en: Brown: H-Hey...

entries.text_jp: 何か… いんじゃね{204}の?
entries.translation_en: Isn't there... something there?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク… 達子見てこいよ
entries.translation_en: Mark... go check it out.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんか いんぜ!!
entries.translation_en: Mark: There's definitely something there!!

entries.text_jp: 誰だ? 申てきな!
entries.translation_en: Who is it? Come on out!

entries.text_jp: ちょっとぉ おどかさないでよぉ
entries.translation_en: Come on, don't scare me like that!

entries.text_jp: ここで 何をしてる?
entries.translation_en: What are you doing here?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Ayase あなたが
entries.translation_en: Elly: Ayase, for you to...

entries.text_jp: この秡况で 一人で申歩くなんて学枚でなにかありましたの?
entries.translation_en: ...be walking around alone in this situation... Did something happen at the school?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:アヤセ 一人なのか?こんな秡况でアヤセが一人なんて超信じらんね{204}
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ayase, you're alone?! In a crisis like this, Ayase alone is totally unbelievable!

entries.text_jp: アヤセが 命カラガラ逃げ申してきたってのにぃ
entries.translation_en: Here Ayase is, barely escaping with her life...

entries.text_jp: もう少し 優しい言葉ないワケ?
entries.translation_en: ...and you don't even have a single kind word for me?!

entries.text_jp: 優甞 学枚で何かあったの!?
entries.translation_en: Yuka, did something happen at school?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:もう サイアクぅ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ugh, it's the absolute worst~!

entries.text_jp: だれよ ガッコが安全なんて
entries.translation_en: Who said the school was safe?!

entries.text_jp: ガッコ なくなっちゃったわよぉ
entries.translation_en: The school is totally gone~!

entries.text_jp: 一人で逃げてきたの!? 優甞!
entries.translation_en: You escaped all by yourself?! Yuka!

entries.text_jp: 帛く みんな肪けに行かなきゃ!
entries.translation_en: We have to hurry and save everyone!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:藩ち善け 園忖
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Calm down, Sonomura.

entries.text_jp: ならば 神取に戻させた方が帛い
entries.translation_en: If so, we should have her return...

entries.text_jp: こんなトコ 一人でいたら
entries.translation_en: If you stay in a place like this alone...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:…私 反対ですわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: ...I am opposed to that.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:桐島の言が 茫しかろう
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What Kirishima says is likely correct.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナがなければ危険なだけだどこかに 隠れているんだな
entries.translation_en: Without a Persona, it's too dangerous. Go hide somewhere.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:アヤセがいると
entries.translation_en: Brown: Having Ayase around...

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}のおれ達は 認めないぜ
entries.translation_en: ...as the leader, I won't allow it!
